svg.title: One crash, two histories
svg.desc: The naive log publishes checkpoint 587, then crashes before uploading that round of tiles. On restart it rebuilds from the entries it finds in storage, which end at 315, and the clients whose submissions were in flight retry in a different order. Its next checkpoint, 640, puts certificate 359 at position 315 where the published checkpoint 587 had certificate 316. Two signed checkpoints disagree about the past: a fork.

text.tspan: entries 0 .. 314: in storage, in every history
retries arrive in a new order
both are signed by the same key. A witness that cosigned 587 can never cosign 640.
